PHYSICAL_EFFECT.meaning: the closed loop commands motor m more than the other motors after the event than before it (VIOLATED: the motor lost physical effect), or, where the motor's telemetry reports a deficit large enough to be tested, does not (NOMINAL). NOT_APPLICABLE with nothing to test; UNAVAILABLE when not measurable or saturated. Cannot say which stage of the propulsion chain failed

expected_inputs: a PX4 ULog with the stock topics (stock_log.py)
fault_behavior: a statistic that cannot be computed is UNAVAILABLE (INPUTS_MISSING), never NOMINAL
validity_rule: XSYS-001's validated T3 window for the same statistic (CTRL_T3)
